text.p: Amerihost Properties Inc said Thursday it is in the process of evaluating preliminary proposals for the acquisition of its outstanding common stock.
The company said it is also consulting with an unnamed investment banking firm to assist with its evaluation.
Amerihost said that no agreement has been reached with respect to any such sale, and there can be no assurances that any transaction will be consummated.
Amerihost owns, builds and manages mid-priced hotels. It currently owns or manages 75 properties with 6,557 rooms, and has an ownership position in 65 of these hotels.
Russ Cerqua, chief financial officer, declined to say whether Amerihost had sought out the preliminary acquisition proposals.
He also declined to comment on when Amerihost might make a decision on the proposals.
